description: Few-shot hook patterns for clip-comp burned captions — in-context learning for Gemini Hook Machine.
patterns: Immediate emotion or reaction beat — not the clip title
Curiosity gap — tease the moment, never the punchline
Pattern interrupt — surprising juxtaposition or contradiction
≤7 words ideal; hard max 12 words; readable in under 3 seconds
No streamer name, no colon prefix, TV-clean

examples.why: Specific embarrassment beat; viewer must watch to see the gift go wrong
Visual struggle + relatable tension; doesn't spoil the beach payoff
Pattern interrupt — odd detail stops the scroll
Shocking visual tease with question mark — curiosity gap
High-energy audio beat without revealing what triggered it
Emotional arc in 5 words — tension before the celebration
Place + disaster hint — must watch for the meltdown
Meta curiosity gap — only works when observation supports a real twist
